verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no capability for selecting many items, such as tasks, PRs or tickets, and applying one action to all of them at once. 'Clear your bug backlog with background cloud agents' and 'Explore design variations in parallel' describe agents working on separate tasks in parallel. That is adjacent to bulk operations but is not a bulk-operation feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
